stimulus: Big Buck Bunny, film 0-185 s (recording of a browser tab playing the film; title card, then the rabbit, bird, squirrels and chinchilla)
labeller: fresh labeller, contact sheets of B2 recording

events.what: Cut from black to the white title card 'Big Buck Bunny' in blue letters.
Title card dissolves into a soft pink-cloud sky (a fade, not a hard cut).
Camera tilts down slowly: a dark conifer and round green bushes rise into frame below the clouds.
Camera keeps descending and distant blue hills and a sunlit yellow-green meadow appear under the trees.
Foreground rocks and small wildflowers slide into the bottom of the frame as the tilt-down ends.
Cut to a still close shot of a stream with pink reflecting water, reeds, flowers and grass on the bank.
Cut to a purple-blue bird with an orange beak perched on a branch against a lilac sky, eyes rolled upward.
Bird shuts its eyes and tilts its head, swaying on the branch.
Bird opens its beak wide, flaps its wings and hops, as if singing.
Bird spreads both wings wide and lifts one foot, eyes closed, mid-song.
Bird settles back with wings folded and eyes closed, looking content.
Bird's eyes pop open and it looks up.
Bird flares its wings out with beak open, startled.
A dark pine cone drops into frame from the top.
Bird leaps off the branch with wings thrown up.
Bird and pine cone are gone, leaving an empty branch with a small feather drifting.
Cut to a wide shot of a mossy mound with a tree growing on it and a dark burrow hole at its base, in dappled sunlight.
Camera pushes in slowly toward the burrow hole while the grass sways in the wind.
Cut to a close view into the dark burrow: mossy rocks at left and a big dark rabbit shape curled inside in shadow.
The sleeping rabbit's face slowly becomes visible in the dark, eyes closed.
Rabbit opens its mouth wide, a yawn.
A rabbit paw reaches forward at the bottom of the frame as the rabbit stirs.
Rabbit lifts its head, one ear flopped over, and light now falls on its face.
Rabbit's eyes open wide and both ears spring upright.
Cut to a wider daylight shot of the burrow on a grassy slope; the rabbit sprawls half out of the hole with a hand on a rock.
Rabbit hauls itself out of the hole.
Rabbit stands up and stretches both arms wide, yawning.
Rabbit drops its arms and relaxes, smiling.
Rabbit starts to walk to the right, away from the burrow.
Cut to a low-angle view of empty blue sky with leaves at the left and right edges.
Rabbit's head rises into frame from below, tilted back with eyes closed, followed by its belly and arms as it breathes in the air.
Cut to a close shot of the rabbit with ears up, half-closed eyes and a contented smile, trees behind.
Rabbit closes its eyes in a happy smile.
Rabbit opens its eyes and looks toward the camera, mouth parting.
Cut to a low shot between large white daisies; the rabbit stands small at right beside a tree, one fist clenched.
Rabbit starts walking toward the camera.
Rabbit's big body looms up and fills the right side of the frame.
Rabbit's face leans in beside a flower, one hand reaching out, and it sniffs the flower with eyes closed.
Cut to the rabbit seen from behind in a meadow, standing still with one arm stretched out to the left.
Cut to a high-angle view from a branch: a dark brown furry head fills the left foreground, apples hang at top right and the small rabbit is far below in the grass.
Cut to an extreme close-up of the rabbit's face and hand beside pale blue flowers.
Rabbit breaks into a wide open-mouthed smile.
Rabbit glances to the side, still smiling, with white daisies now in the foreground.
Cut to a top-down view of the rabbit lying in dark grass among blue flowers, a big pink butterfly fluttering at the left edge.
Butterfly flutters right in front of the rabbit's face while the rabbit watches it, one arm extended.
Butterfly flies over the rabbit's body toward the right as the rabbit turns to follow it.
Cut to a wide meadow shot: the rabbit stands at left looking up at a butterfly above its head, green trees behind.
Butterfly settles briefly on top of the rabbit's head between its ears.
Butterfly flies off to the right and sinks toward the grass, the rabbit's eyes following it.
Rabbit brings both hands together at its chest, trying to catch the butterfly.
A red apple appears in the grass near the rabbit and rolls to a stop; the butterfly is gone.
Rabbit unclasps its hands, stands tall and looks down at the apple.
Rabbit bends down and grabs the apple.
Rabbit straightens up and lifts the apple to chest height, eyeing it.
Cut to a low-angle view up into an apple tree with red apples among the leaves; the rabbit's ear and head are at lower left.
Rabbit's ear straightens upright and its head turns as it looks toward the tree.
Cut back to the wide meadow: the rabbit stands holding the red apple at its side with a worried look.
Rabbit raises the apple to its mouth and takes a bite.
Rabbit lowers the apple and turns toward the left.
Rabbit walks off to the left, hunched over the apple.
Rabbit leaves the frame at the left, leaving an empty meadow.
A pink butterfly flutters in from the right edge and flies left over the trees.
Cut to a high-angle view from a branch: a dark red-brown furry head and ear fill the left foreground, red apples at top right, and the tiny rabbit far below.
Cut to a similar high-angle view with a big red apple at top left; the furry head is gone and only its hand slides out at the left edge, the tiny rabbit near the bottom center.
Cut to a close side view of the rabbit looking off to the left, ears up, with a pale sky and meadow behind.
Rabbit lowers its arm, holding a half-eaten apple core, and looks at it.
Rabbit lifts the apple core up in its hand, studying it.
A purple butterfly flies in at the right edge.
Rabbit's hand drops low and the apple core is no longer visible; the butterfly hovers over its shoulder.
Butterfly lands on the rabbit's forehead and the rabbit goes cross-eyed.
Butterfly lifts off and flies to the upper left while the rabbit's eyes and head follow it.
Butterfly flutters out at the left edge while the rabbit breaks into a broad grin.
Rabbit leans hard to the left with an arm out, lunging after the butterfly.
Cut to a wide low shot of a meadow with trees: the rabbit's huge foot and rump stride past at right, a purple butterfly at top left.
Rabbit, seen from behind, walks away from the camera with one arm raised toward the butterfly.
Rabbit, now small near the tree, reaches up and grabs at the butterfly.
A reddish-brown round object pokes in at the right edge of the frame.
A big dark grey-purple furry animal, back to camera, fills the right side of the foreground while the small rabbit keeps reaching for the butterfly.
A red-orange pointed ear or head of another animal peeks over the grey animal at the top right.
Cut to a medium shot of a red-furred squirrel leaning over a blue-grey chinchilla that holds a chestnut, in front of green bushes.
A brown squirrel with a big blue eye creeps into frame from the lower left, low to the ground.
Brown squirrel sits up on its haunches with its big tail curled and looks off to the right.
Cut to a shot of a thick tree trunk: the rabbit seen from behind at right reaches an arm toward a pink-purple butterfly in front of the trunk.
Rabbit turns its head toward the camera, smiling, as the butterfly flutters upward.
Cut to the rabbit's huge grey side filling the left half of the frame, a tree trunk and grass at right.
A small brown squirrel peeks out from behind the tree trunk at the right.
Squirrel scrambles out onto the root with its tail up, looking up at the rabbit.
Cut to a medium shot of the rabbit smiling in front of the tree, a purple butterfly hovering above its head.
Butterfly alights on top of the rabbit's head between its ears.
Butterfly flies away out of the shot and the rabbit's grin fades to a blank, wary look.
A brown squirrel appears at the right edge, clinging to the tree trunk beside the rabbit.
A red-orange furred animal hangs upside-down from the leaves at the top left.
The purple butterfly flutters back in between the rabbit and the squirrel.
Butterfly hovers above the rabbit's head while the rabbit folds an arm across its belly and looks off, thoughtful.
Brown squirrel scurries and leaps up the trunk to above the rabbit's ears.
The upside-down red animal is gone from the top left and the butterfly flutters out at the left edge.
A single green leaf starts to fall slowly past the tree, drifting down through the shot.
Rabbit raises a hand to its chin, thinking, as the leaf drifts down.
Rabbit drops its hand, perks its ears up and looks up toward the squirrel.
Rabbit leans toward the camera with a startled face, its big head sliding off to the right.
Rabbit has left the frame, leaving the squirrel alone on the trunk.
Squirrel flips head-down on the trunk and glares at the camera.
Cut to a top-down view of yellow-green grass with a tiny rabbit near a tree canopy at the top left.
The tiny rabbit walks slowly down and across the grass.
Cut to a sunlit rock and tree base: a blue-grey chinchilla sits at the right clutching a chestnut.
A red squirrel pops up behind the chinchilla at the right.
A brown squirrel scrambles down onto the rock from the top left, tail arched.
Chinchilla holds its chestnut up beside its head while the brown squirrel, mouth open, scolds.
The chestnut is gone from the chinchilla's paws and it looks anxious.
A small red-brown curved object, possibly a chestnut half, appears in the grass at the bottom right.
Cut to the rabbit standing alone in a yellow-green meadow, facing the camera, hands at its sides.
A small dark nut flies in from the left and strikes near the rabbit's head.
Rabbit's head jerks and its ears flick, wincing from the hit.
Rabbit turns toward the left with an annoyed squint.
Rabbit puts its hands on its hips and looks up and off to the side.
Cut to the three animals on the rock: brown squirrel at left, red squirrel in the middle with a toothy grin, chinchilla at right.
Red squirrel gestures with its arm and grins while the brown squirrel smirks.
Cut to a big close-up of the rabbit, eyes wide and mouth open, ears moving.
Rabbit's eyes dart sideways and its ears sway.
Cut back to the three animals on the rock, grinning.
Red squirrel's eyes go wide and it tilts its head while the brown squirrel glowers.
Red squirrel lifts a green nut in its raised hand beside its head, grinning.
Cut to the rabbit close-up, mouth ajar and eyes looking to the right.
Rabbit frowns and its eyes dart to the right.
Cut back to the animals: the red squirrel holds the green nut up, the brown squirrel grimacing.
Red squirrel cocks its arm back with the nut.
Cut to the rabbit's face in close-up, eyes shut and mouth pursed.
Rabbit drops down out of frame, leaving only its two ear tips at the bottom edge.
Rabbit rises back up into the frame, eyes darting right, one ear flopped.
Rabbit straightens up fully with ears upright and a worried sidelong look.
A brown nut flies into the frame at the upper left.
Rabbit winces, one eye squeezed shut.
More nuts, a dark brown one and a green acorn, fly in from the top and left around the rabbit's head.
Cut to the animals: brown squirrel glaring toward us, red squirrel behind it, chinchilla holding an acorn at the right.
Chinchilla now clutches a red-brown chestnut and the red squirrel waves an arm.
Chinchilla grins with eyes nearly shut.
Cut to the rabbit standing full-body in a yellow meadow with a dark nut flying in at the upper left.
A green acorn and then a brown nut arc in from the left past the rabbit's head while it tilts its head with a glum look.
A green pear drops from the top of the frame onto the rabbit's head, which droops with eyes shut.
A brown nut hits the rabbit's ear and head.
Another nut thuds into the rabbit's belly and drops away.
A red apple drops in above the rabbit's head.
Cut back to the squirrel, red squirrel and chinchilla on the rock, the chinchilla clutching an acorn.
